name: OpenAI Codex CLI
description: Installs the OpenAI Codex coding-agent CLI. Add a Node.js Feature or use a Node.js base image; this Feature does not install Node.js.

version.description: Codex CLI version to install. 'latest' is the rolling default; use an exact version for reproducible containers.

model.description: Default Codex model, written to the system config /etc/codex/config.toml. Users can still override it in ~/.codex/config.toml or with --model. Empty leaves Codex's upstream default.
